Component(dsl: 1, id: "corpus/styling", name: "Styling", kind: Kind.section,
  description: "Flutter Text and Container properties",
  states: [BoolState(name: "raised", default: false)],
  variants: [Variant(id: "default", label: "Default", build: Column(gap: Space.md, children: [
    Text(child: "Styled text", size: FontSize.lg, weight: FontWeight.bold, maxLines: 1, align: TextAlign.justify,
      fontStyle: FontStyle.italic, letterSpacing: 1.5, wordSpacing: 4, lineHeight: 1.4, background: Color.surface,
      decoration: TextDecoration.underline, decorationColor: Color.primary, decorationStyle: TextDecorationStyle.wavy,
      decorationThickness: 2, fontFamily: "Inter", shadow: Shadow.sm, overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
      softWrap: false, textDirection: TextDirection.ltr, semanticsLabel: "Styled"),
    Text(child: "Legacy align", align: Align.center, strike: true),
    Box(padding: Space.md, margin: Insets(x: 8, y: 4), alignment: Anchor.center,
      gradient: Gradient(from: Color.primary, to: Color.surface, begin: Anchor.left, end: Anchor.right),
      radius: Radius.md, border: Border(width: 1), shadow: state.raised ? Shadow.lg : Shadow.sm,
      minWidth: 40, maxHeight: 400, rotate: 3, scale: 1.02, opacity: 0.9, id: "card",
      child: Text(child: "Box")),
    Box(shape: BoxShape.circle, radius: Radius.full, background: Color.primary, width: 48, height: 48,
      onTap: Toggle(state: "raised"), ariaLabel: "Raise", child: Text(child: "+"))
  ]))],
)
